def: to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach

occurrences.text: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
